headline: Executive order sets out core principles the federal government should follow when regulating the US financial system.
what_it_does: This order lays out a set of basic principles to guide how the federal government regulates banks and the wider financial system. No summary was provided, so the specific principles, any instructions to agencies, and any deadlines cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are the agencies expected to apply the order's principles when making and reviewing financial rules.
They could see changes in the rules they must follow if agencies act on these principles.
